chapterInfo.content:
12
Yeremia asɛmmisa ne n’abooboodie
1 # Hiob 21.7; Dwom 73.3 O AWURADE, sɛ me ne wo bɔ nkuro a,
wodi bem ara;
nanso me ne wo bɛkasa ara:
Adɛn nti na abɔnefoɔ kwan si wɔn yie
na nkɔnkɔnsafoɔ nyinaa nso ho dwo wɔn?
2Wotɛ wɔn, na wɔgye nhini;
wɔnyinyini na wɔsoso aba nso;
wobɛn wɔn ano,
na wo ne wɔn akoma ntam twe.
3Nanso wo, AWURADE, wonim me;
wohu me; na wosɔ m’akoma hwɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ wɔ wo fam.
Tutu wɔn sɛ nnwan a wɔrekɔku wɔn,
na hyira wɔn so sie ma okum da.
4 # Yer 9.10 Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na asase no nni abooboo,
na afuom ahahan ntwintwam?
Ɛsofoɔ bɔne no nti
mmoa ne nnomaa awie sa,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔka sɛ: Ɔrenhunu yɛn awieeɛ.
5Sɛ wo ne anammɔnfoɔ mpo tu mmirika na wɔma wobrɛ a,
ɛnneɛ ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wo ne apɔnkɔ bɛsi ammirikakane?
Na sɛ asase a ɛso da hɔ no so mpo, wohwe ase a,
ɛnneɛ wobɛyɛ dɛn Yordan kwaeɛ no mu?
6Na wo nuanom nso ne w’agya fie,
wɔn mpo twa wo nkontompo,
wɔn nso wɔteam denden di w’akyi;
sɛ wɔka nnɔkɔnnɔkɔsɛm kyerɛ wo a,
nnye wɔn nni.
7Magya me fie,
mato m’agyapadeɛ agu;
mede me kra dɔfoɔ
mahyɛ n’atamfo nsa.
8M’agyapadeɛ adane me
sɛ kwaeɛ mu gyata;
wama ne nne so atia me,
enti na makyiri no.
9M’agyapadeɛ adane me ɔkɔdeɛ a ɔda nso?
Akɔdeɛ atwa ho ahyia?
Monkɔ nkɔboaboa wiram mmoadoma nyinaa ano
mmra, na wɔmmɛdidi.
10Mmoahwɛfoɔ pii asɛe me bobeturo
atiatia me kyɛfa so,
wɔadane me kyɛfa fɛfɛ no
ayɛ no ɛserɛ pataa;
11wɔasɛe no pasaa,
ayɛ dwerɛbee di me ho abooboo;
wɔasɛe asase no nyinaa,
nso obiara nni hɔ a ɔde sie n’akoma mu.
12Asɛefoɔ aba
anwea pradada so mpampa nyinaa so,
na AWURADE afena retwitwa
afiri asase ano akɔsi asase ano;
asomdwoeɛ nni hɔ mma ɔhonam biara.
13 # Deut 28.38; Hos 8.7 Wɔguu ayuo, na wɔtwaa nnwerɛ;
wɔbrɛe, na wɔannya mu hwee.
Na wɔn ani bɛwuwu mo nnɔbaeɛ ho,
AWURADE abufuhyeɛ no nti.
AWURADE bɛdom wɔn a wɔnu wɔn ho
14Sei na AWURADE ka no wɔn a wɔtete me ho no nyinaa ho: Nnipa bɔne a wɔde wɔn nsa aka agyapadeɛ a mede memaa me man Israel sɛ wɔnnie no, hwɛ, meretutu wɔn afiri wɔn asase so, na mɛtu Yuda fie afiri wɔn mu. 15Na ɛbɛba sɛ matu wɔn no akyiri no, mɛsane mahu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na mede wɔn nyinaa asane aba wɔn agyapadeɛ mu ne wɔn asase so mmaako mmaako. 16#Yer 4.2; Deut 6.13 Na sɛ wɔbɛsua me man akwan yie, aka me din ho ntam sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ yi; sɛdeɛ wɔkyerɛɛ me man sɛ wɔnka Baal ntam no a; ɛnneɛ wɔbɛyɛne wɔn wɔ me man mu. 17Na sɛ wɔantie a, ɛnneɛ mɛtu saa ɔman no agu, mɛtutu na masɛe wɔn, AWURADE asɛm nie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
